IBM-specific parameter block for CKM_IBM_BTC_DERIVE supporting BIP-0032/SLIP-0010 key derivations. functions.name: C_Initialize
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_Initialize(void *init_args)
functions.description: Initializes the Cryptoki (PKCS #11) library. If provided, init_args points to a struct ck_c_initialize_args to set mutex callbacks and flags; otherwise defaults are used. Call this exactly once before any other function.
requirements: Must be called before any other PKCS #11 function.
Call exactly once per process; repeated calls without C_Finalize lead to CKR_CRYPTOKI_ALREADY_INITIALIZED (per standard behavior).
init_args may be NULL or a pointer to struct ck_c_initialize_args; if provided, fields must be valid for the life of the library.
Threading model and OS-locking behavior depend on flags in ck_c_initialize_args.

functions.name: C_Finalize
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_Finalize(void *reserved)
functions.description: Finalizes the Cryptoki library and releases resources. After this, no other function except C_Initialize should be called.
requirements: reserved must be NULL (per PKCS #11 convention).
Must be called after C_Initialize, and no other active sessions/operations should remain (providers may enforce operation/session cleanup).

functions.name: C_GetInfo
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetInfo(struct ck_info *info)
functions.description: Returns general information about the Cryptoki library (version, manufacturer, library description/version).
requirements: info must be a valid, writable pointer.
C_Initialize should have been called before.

functions.name: C_GetFunctionList
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetFunctionList(struct ck_function_list **function_list)
functions.description: Returns a table of function pointers implementing the core PKCS #11 API.
requirements: function_list must be a valid writable pointer to receive the function list.
The returned table remains valid for the lifetime of the module (until C_Finalize).

functions.name: C_GetSlotList
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetSlotList(unsigned char token_present, ck_slot_id_t *slot_list, unsigned long *count)
functions.description: Obtains the list of slot IDs. If slot_list is NULL, returns the number of slots in count; otherwise fills up to *count entries.
requirements: count must be a valid writable pointer.
If slot_list is non-NULL, it must point to an array with space for at least *count entries.
token_present filters to only slots with tokens when nonzero.

functions.name: C_GetSlotInfo
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetSlotInfo(ck_slot_id_t slot_id, struct ck_slot_info *info)
functions.description: Retrieves hardware/manufacturer/flags and version information for a slot.
requirements: slot_id must identify a valid slot.
info must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: C_GetTokenInfo
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetTokenInfo(ck_slot_id_t slot_id, struct ck_token_info *info)
functions.description: Retrieves information about the token in a slot (label, serial, memory sizes, flags, versions, time).
requirements: slot_id must refer to a slot with a present/recognized token.
info must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: C_WaitForSlotEvent
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_WaitForSlotEvent(ck_flags_t flags, ck_slot_id_t *slot, void *reserved)
functions.description: Blocks (or not, depending on flags) until a slot event (e.g., token insertion/removal) occurs, returning the affected slot ID.
requirements: If CKF_DONT_BLOCK is not set, the call may block indefinitely until an event.
slot must be a valid writable pointer to receive a slot ID.
reserved must be NULL.

functions.name: C_GetMechanismList
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetMechanismList(ck_slot_id_t slot_id, ck_mechanism_type_t *mechanism_list, unsigned long *count)
functions.description: Returns the list of mechanism types supported by the token in the given slot. If mechanism_list is NULL, returns the number in count.
requirements: slot_id must refer to a valid slot with a token.
count must be a valid writable pointer.
If mechanism_list is non-NULL, it must point to an array of at least *count entries.

functions.name: C_GetMechanismInfo
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetMechanismInfo(ck_slot_id_t slot_id, ck_mechanism_type_t type, struct ck_mechanism_info *info)
functions.description: Provides capability information (key sizes, flags) for a specific mechanism on a token.
requirements: slot_id must be valid; a token must be present.
type must be a mechanism supported by the token.
info must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: C_InitToken
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_InitToken(ck_slot_id_t slot_id, unsigned char *pin, unsigned long pin_len, unsigned char *label)
functions.description: Initializes (formats) a token, setting the Security Officer (SO) PIN and token label.
requirements: slot_id must refer to a slot with an initialized device capable of token init.
pin must point to SO PIN bytes; pin_len is its length; constraints depend on token policy (min/max).
label must point to at least 32 bytes (per CK_TOKEN_INFO.label size) to set the label, typically padded as required by the token.

functions.name: C_InitPIN
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_InitPIN(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *pin, unsigned long pin_len)
functions.description: Initializes the normal USER PIN (typically by SO).
requirements: session must be a valid logged-in SO session with sufficient rights per token policy.
pin must point to the new USER PIN; pin_len within token’s allowed range.

functions.name: C_SetPIN
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SetPIN(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *old_pin, unsigned long old_len, unsigned char *new_pin, unsigned long new_len)
functions.description: Changes the PIN for the currently logged-in user type (SO or USER).
requirements: session must be valid and in a state that permits PIN change.
old_pin/new_pin must point to buffers with lengths old_len/new_len within token policy.

functions.name: C_OpenSession
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_OpenSession(ck_slot_id_t slot_id, ck_flags_t flags, void *application, ck_notify_t notify, ck_session_handle_t *session)
functions.description: Opens a session with the token in the given slot. Returns a session handle. Optionally registers an application-specific pointer and notification callback.
requirements: slot_id must refer to a valid slot with a token present.
flags must include CKF_SERIAL_SESSION; CKF_RW_SESSION controls read/write capability; CKF_ASYNC_SESSION if supported.
session must be a valid writable pointer.
If notify is non-NULL, it must remain valid for the session lifetime; application is passed back on callbacks.

functions.name: C_CloseSession
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_CloseSession(ck_session_handle_t session)
functions.description: Closes a single session and aborts any active operations in that session.
requirements: session must be a valid session handle.

functions.name: C_CloseAllSessions
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_CloseAllSessions(ck_slot_id_t slot_id)
functions.description: Closes all sessions on the specified slot.
requirements: slot_id must refer to a valid slot with sessions opened by the caller/process.

functions.name: C_GetSessionInfo
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetSessionInfo(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_session_info *info)
functions.description: Returns information about a session (slot, state, flags, device error).
requirements: session must be valid.
info must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: C_GetOperationState
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetOperationState(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *operation_state, unsigned long *operation_state_len)
functions.description: Exports the cryptographic operation state for a session, to resume later (module-dependent).
requirements: session must be valid and have an active operation that supports state export.
operation_state_len must be a valid writable pointer; if operation_state is NULL, the required length is returned in *operation_state_len.
If operation_state is non-NULL, it must have at least *operation_state_len bytes of space.

functions.name: C_SetOperationState
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SetOperationState(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *operation_state, unsigned long operation_state_len, ck_object_handle_t encryption_key, ck_object_handle_t authentication_key)
functions.description: Imports/restores a previously saved operation state into a session.
requirements: session must be valid and in a compatible state for the restored operation.
operation_state must point to a buffer of length operation_state_len previously obtained via C_GetOperationState.
encryption_key/authentication_key must reference appropriate keys if the state requires them (mechanism-dependent).

functions.name: C_Login
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_Login(ck_session_handle_t session, ck_user_type_t user_type, unsigned char *pin, unsigned long pin_len)
functions.description: Logs a user into the token (USER, SO, or CONTEXT_SPECIFIC) using a PIN when required.
requirements: session must be valid and associated with a token requiring login.
user_type must be CKU_SO, CKU_USER, or CKU_CONTEXT_SPECIFIC as supported.
pin may be NULL for tokens with protected authentication path; otherwise must point to a buffer of length pin_len.

functions.name: C_Logout
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_Logout(ck_session_handle_t session)
functions.description: Logs out the current user from the session/token, ending authenticated state.
requirements: session must be valid and in a logged-in state for logout to succeed.

functions.name: C_CreateObject
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_CreateObject(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_attribute *templ, unsigned long count, ck_object_handle_t *object)
functions.description: Creates a new object on the token/session per the provided attribute template.
requirements: session must be valid with sufficient rights (e.g., RW for token objects).
templ must point to an array of count attributes describing the object; attribute values and lengths must be valid.
object must be a valid writable pointer to receive the handle.

functions.name: C_CopyObject
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_CopyObject(ck_session_handle_t session, ck_object_handle_t object, struct ck_attribute *templ, unsigned long count, ck_object_handle_t *new_object)
functions.description: Creates a copy of an existing object, optionally modifying attributes as allowed by the token’s policy.
requirements: session must be valid; appropriate access (e.g., RW) may be required.
object must be a valid handle to an existing object.
templ/count may be NULL/0 or a valid attribute array; only modifiable attributes may be set.
new_object must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: C_DestroyObject
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DestroyObject(ck_session_handle_t session, ck_object_handle_t object)
functions.description: Destroys an object on the token or in the session.
requirements: session must be valid with sufficient rights.
object must be a valid handle referring to a destroyable object.

functions.name: C_GetObjectSize
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetObjectSize(ck_session_handle_t session, ck_object_handle_t object, unsigned long *size)
functions.description: Returns the size in bytes of the specified object.
requirements: session must be valid.
object must be a valid handle.
size must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: C_GetAttributeValue
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetAttributeValue(ck_session_handle_t session, ck_object_handle_t object, struct ck_attribute *templ, unsigned long count)
functions.description: Retrieves attributes of an object. For each templ[i], fills value and value_len according to PKCS #11 rules.
requirements: session must be valid; access may require login depending on object sensitivity.
object must be valid.
templ must point to an array of count attributes; for output, value may be NULL to query length; otherwise value must have space of value_len bytes.

functions.name: C_SetAttributeValue
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SetAttributeValue(ck_session_handle_t session, ck_object_handle_t object, struct ck_attribute *templ, unsigned long count)
functions.description: Modifies object attributes that are allowed to be changed.
requirements: session must be valid and have rights to modify the object (typically RW, logged in).
object must be valid.
templ must be a valid array of count attributes with value/value_len set for inputs; only modifiable attributes are accepted.

functions.name: C_FindObjectsInit
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_FindObjectsInit(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_attribute *templ, unsigned long count)
functions.description: Initializes an object search within a session using an attribute template as a filter.
requirements: session must be valid and not already in a find operation (one active find per session).
templ may be NULL/0 for unfiltered search or a valid array of count attributes.

functions.name: C_FindObjects
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_FindObjects(ck_session_handle_t session, ck_object_handle_t *object, unsigned long max_object_count, unsigned long *object_count)
functions.description: Continues an initialized object search, returning up to max_object_count matching object handles.
requirements: session must be valid and have an active find (started with C_FindObjectsInit).
object must point to an array with capacity for max_object_count handles.
object_count must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: C_FindObjectsFinal
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_FindObjectsFinal(ck_session_handle_t session)
functions.description: Terminates an active object search initialized by C_FindObjectsInit.
requirements: session must be valid and currently in a find operation.

functions.name: C_EncryptInit
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_EncryptInit(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, ck_object_handle_t key)
functions.description: Initializes an encryption operation for the given mechanism and key.
requirements: session must be valid and not already performing a conflicting operation.
mechanism must point to a valid struct ck_mechanism appropriate for the key.
key must be a handle to a key object with CKA_ENCRYPT permitted.

functions.name: C_Encrypt
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_Encrypt(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *data, unsigned long data_len, unsigned char *encrypted_data, unsigned long *encrypted_data_len)
functions.description: Single-part encryption of data previously initialized with C_EncryptInit.
requirements: session must be valid and initialized for encryption.
data/data_len specify input to encrypt and must be valid.
encrypted_data_len must be writable; if encrypted_data is NULL, the required size is returned; otherwise buffer must be large enough.

functions.name: C_EncryptUpdate
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_EncryptUpdate(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *part, unsigned long part_len, unsigned char *encrypted_part, unsigned long *encrypted_part_len)
functions.description: Continues a multi-part encryption operation.
requirements: session must be valid and encryption must have been initialized via C_EncryptInit.
part/part_len must be valid for input.
encrypted_part_len must be writable; encrypted_part may be NULL to query required size.

functions.name: C_EncryptFinal
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_EncryptFinal(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *last_encrypted_part, unsigned long *last_encrypted_part_len)
functions.description: Finishes a multi-part encryption operation, outputting any final bytes (e.g., padding).
requirements: session must be valid and in an active encrypt operation.
last_encrypted_part_len must be writable; last_encrypted_part may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_DecryptInit
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DecryptInit(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, ck_object_handle_t key)
functions.description: Initializes a decryption operation for the given mechanism and key.
requirements: session must be valid and not in a conflicting operation.
mechanism must be valid for the key and ciphertext format.
key must be a handle to a key object with CKA_DECRYPT permitted.

functions.name: C_Decrypt
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_Decrypt(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *encrypted_data, unsigned long encrypted_data_len, unsigned char *data, unsigned long *data_len)
functions.description: Single-part decryption of data previously initialized with C_DecryptInit.
requirements: session must be valid and decryption initialized.
encrypted_data/encrypted_data_len must be valid.
data_len must be writable; if data is NULL, module returns required size; otherwise buffer must be large enough.

functions.name: C_DecryptUpdate
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DecryptUpdate(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *encrypted_part, unsigned long encrypted_part_len, unsigned char *part, unsigned long *part_len)
functions.description: Continues a multi-part decryption operation.
requirements: session must be valid and decryption initialized.
encrypted_part/encrypted_part_len must be valid input.
part_len must be writable; part may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_DecryptFinal
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DecryptFinal(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *last_part, unsigned long *last_part_len)
functions.description: Finishes a multi-part decryption operation, returning any remaining plaintext (e.g., after unpadding).
requirements: session must be valid and in an active decrypt operation.
last_part_len must be writable; last_part may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_DigestInit
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DigestInit(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism)
functions.description: Initializes a digest (hash) operation for the given mechanism.
requirements: session must be valid and not in a conflicting operation.
mechanism must be a supported digest mechanism.

functions.name: C_Digest
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_Digest(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *data, unsigned long data_len, unsigned char *digest, unsigned long *digest_len)
functions.description: Single-part digest of data previously initialized with C_DigestInit.
requirements: session must be valid and digest initialized.
data/data_len must be valid input.
digest_len must be writable; if digest is NULL, returns required length; otherwise buffer must be large enough.

functions.name: C_DigestUpdate
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DigestUpdate(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *part, unsigned long part_len)
functions.description: Feeds additional data into an active multi-part digest operation.
requirements: session must be valid and digest initialized.
part/part_len must be valid input.

functions.name: C_DigestKey
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DigestKey(ck_session_handle_t session, ck_object_handle_t key)
functions.description: Contributes a key’s value into the active digest operation (mechanism and token permitting).
requirements: session must be valid and digest initialized.
key must be a valid handle to a key whose attributes permit digesting (not sensitive/undigestible).

functions.name: C_DigestFinal
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DigestFinal(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *digest, unsigned long *digest_len)
functions.description: Finalizes a digest operation, returning the message digest.
requirements: session must be valid and in a digest operation.
digest_len must be writable; digest may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_SignInit
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SignInit(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, ck_object_handle_t key)
functions.description: Initializes a signature operation for the given mechanism and private/secret key.
requirements: session must be valid and not in a conflicting operation.
mechanism must be valid for signing with the provided key.
key must be a handle to a key with CKA_SIGN permitted.

functions.name: C_Sign
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_Sign(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *data, unsigned long data_len, unsigned char *signature, unsigned long *signature_len)
functions.description: Single-part signature over data as configured by C_SignInit (either raw or with hashing per mechanism).
requirements: session must be valid and sign initialized.
data/data_len must be valid input.
signature_len must be writable; signature may be NULL to get required size.

functions.name: C_SignUpdate
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SignUpdate(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *part, unsigned long part_len)
functions.description: Feeds data into a multi-part signature operation (mechanisms that support it).
requirements: session must be valid and sign initialized with a multi-part capable mechanism.
part/part_len must be valid input.

functions.name: C_SignFinal
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SignFinal(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *signature, unsigned long *signature_len)
functions.description: Finalizes a multi-part signature operation, returning the signature.
requirements: session must be valid and in a sign operation.
signature_len must be writable; signature may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_SignRecoverInit
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SignRecoverInit(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, ck_object_handle_t key)
functions.description: Initializes a sign-recover operation where signing and message recovery are combined (mechanism-dependent).
requirements: session must be valid and not in conflicting operation.
mechanism must support sign-recover with the provided key.
key must allow CKA_SIGN_RECOVER.

functions.name: C_SignRecover
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SignRecover(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *data, unsigned long data_len, unsigned char *signature, unsigned long *signature_len)
functions.description: Performs a single-part sign-recover operation, producing a signature and possibly recovering data depending on mechanism semantics.
requirements: session must be valid and sign-recover initialized.
data/data_len valid input.
signature_len must be writable; signature may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_VerifyInit
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_VerifyInit(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, ck_object_handle_t key)
functions.description: Initializes a signature verification operation for the given mechanism and public/secret key.
requirements: session must be valid and not in a conflicting operation.
mechanism must be valid for verify with provided key.
key must allow CKA_VERIFY.

functions.name: C_Verify
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_Verify(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *data, unsigned long data_len, unsigned char *signature, unsigned long signature_len)
functions.description: Single-part signature verification for data as configured by C_VerifyInit.
requirements: session must be valid and verify initialized.
data/data_len and signature/signature_len must be valid inputs.

functions.name: C_VerifyUpdate
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_VerifyUpdate(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *part, unsigned long part_len)
functions.description: Feeds data into a multi-part verify operation (mechanisms that support it).
requirements: session must be valid and verify initialized with a multi-part capable mechanism.
part/part_len must be valid input.

functions.name: C_VerifyFinal
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_VerifyFinal(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *signature, unsigned long signature_len)
functions.description: Finalizes a multi-part verify operation, verifying the provided signature against the accumulated data.
requirements: session must be valid and in a verify operation.
signature/signature_len must be valid inputs.

functions.name: C_VerifyRecoverInit
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_VerifyRecoverInit(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, ck_object_handle_t key)
functions.description: Initializes a verify-recover operation (mechanisms that support message recovery during verification).
requirements: session must be valid and not in conflicting operation.
mechanism must support verify-recover.
key must allow CKA_VERIFY_RECOVER.

functions.name: C_VerifyRecover
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_VerifyRecover(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *signature, unsigned long signature_len, unsigned char *data, unsigned long *data_len)
functions.description: Performs single-part verify-recover, returning recovered data when applicable.
requirements: session must be valid and verify-recover initialized.
signature/signature_len valid input.
data_len must be writable; data may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_DigestEncryptUpdate
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DigestEncryptUpdate(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *part, unsigned long part_len, unsigned char *encrypted_part, unsigned long *encrypted_part_len)
functions.description: Continues a combined digest-and-encrypt operation in one call (if mechanism combination is supported).
requirements: session must be valid and appropriately initialized for combined operation.
part/part_len valid input; encrypted_part_len must be writable; encrypted_part may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_DecryptDigestUpdate
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DecryptDigestUpdate(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *encrypted_part, unsigned long encrypted_part_len, unsigned char *part, unsigned long *part_len)
functions.description: Continues a combined decrypt-and-digest operation in one call.
requirements: session must be valid and appropriately initialized.
encrypted_part/encrypted_part_len valid input; part_len must be writable; part may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_SignEncryptUpdate
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SignEncryptUpdate(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *part, unsigned long part_len, unsigned char *encrypted_part, unsigned long *encrypted_part_len)
functions.description: Continues a combined sign-and-encrypt operation in one call.
requirements: session must be valid and appropriately initialized for sign and encrypt.
part/part_len valid input; encrypted_part_len must be writable; encrypted_part may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_DecryptVerifyUpdate
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DecryptVerifyUpdate(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *encrypted_part, unsigned long encrypted_part_len, unsigned char *part, unsigned long *part_len)
functions.description: Continues a combined decrypt-and-verify operation in one call.
requirements: session must be valid and appropriately initialized for decrypt and verify.
encrypted_part/encrypted_part_len valid input; part_len must be writable; part may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_GenerateKey
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GenerateKey(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, struct ck_attribute *templ, unsigned long count, ck_object_handle_t *key)
functions.description: Generates a secret or domain-parameter key using the specified mechanism and attribute template.
requirements: session must be valid and typically RW.
mechanism must be a supported key generation mechanism; may require parameters.
templ/count must describe the new key’s attributes; values must be valid; token may enforce required attributes.
key must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: C_GenerateKeyPair
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GenerateKeyPair(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, struct ck_attribute *public_key_template, unsigned long public_key_attribute_count, struct ck_attribute *private_key_template, unsigned long private_key_attribute_count, ck_object_handle_t *public_key, ck_object_handle_t *private_key)
functions.description: Generates a public/private key pair using the specified mechanism and attribute templates.
requirements: session must be valid and RW.
mechanism must be a supported key-pair generation mechanism with any required parameters.
public/private templates must be valid arrays describing each object; token may require certain attributes.
public_key and private_key must be valid writable pointers.

functions.name: C_WrapKey
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_WrapKey(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, ck_object_handle_t wrapping_key, ck_object_handle_t key, unsigned char *wrapped_key, unsigned long *wrapped_key_len)
functions.description: Wraps (exports) a key under another key using the given mechanism.
requirements: session must be valid and have rights to use wrapping_key for wrap and key for being wrapped.
mechanism must be a supported wrapping mechanism.
wrapped_key_len must be writable; wrapped_key may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_UnwrapKey
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_UnwrapKey(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, ck_object_handle_t unwrapping_key, unsigned char *wrapped_key, unsigned long wrapped_key_len, struct ck_attribute *templ, unsigned long attribute_count, ck_object_handle_t *key)
functions.description: Unwraps (imports) a key from wrapped form using the given mechanism and unwrapping key, creating a new key object per template.
requirements: session must be valid and RW with appropriate login if needed.
mechanism must be a supported unwrap mechanism compatible with unwrapping_key.
wrapped_key/wrapped_key_len must be valid input.
templ must be a valid array describing attributes for the new key; token may require specific attributes.
key must be a valid writable pointer.

functions.name: C_DeriveKey
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DeriveKey(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, ck_object_handle_t base_key, struct ck_attribute *templ, unsigned long attribute_count, ck_object_handle_t *key)
functions.description: Derives a new key from a base key using the specified mechanism and creates the derived key per template.
requirements: session must be valid and RW; login may be required.
mechanism must be a supported key derivation mechanism with correct parameters.
base_key must be valid and allow CKA_DERIVE.
templ must be valid; key must be a writable pointer.

functions.name: C_SeedRandom
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SeedRandom(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *seed, unsigned long seed_len)
functions.description: Mixes additional seed material into the token’s RNG (if supported).
requirements: session must be valid; token must support seeding.
seed/seed_len must specify the seed buffer.

functions.name: C_GenerateRandom
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GenerateRandom(ck_session_handle_t session, unsigned char *random_data, unsigned long random_len)
functions.description: Generates random bytes from the token’s RNG.
requirements: session must be valid.
random_data must point to a buffer of at least random_len bytes; random_len > 0.

functions.name: C_GetFunctionStatus
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetFunctionStatus(ck_session_handle_t session)
functions.description: Returns the status of a function invoked in asynchronous mode (legacy, rarely used).
requirements: session must be valid and associated with an async operation if supported.

functions.name: C_CancelFunction
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_CancelFunction(ck_session_handle_t session)
functions.description: Attempts to cancel a function invoked in asynchronous mode (legacy, optional).
requirements: session must be valid and associated with a cancellable async operation if supported.

functions.name: C_GetInterfaceList
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetInterfaceList(struct ck_interface *interfaces_list, unsigned long *count)
functions.description: Returns the list of available Cryptoki interfaces (names, function lists, flags).
requirements: count must be a valid writable pointer.
If interfaces_list is NULL, *count is set to the number of interfaces; otherwise it must have space for at least *count entries.

functions.name: C_GetInterface
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_GetInterface(unsigned char *interface_name, struct ck_version *version, struct ck_interface **interface_, ck_flags_t flags)
functions.description: Returns a specific interface by name/version and its function list/flags.
requirements: interface_name must be a valid string for the desired interface (or NULL for default, per provider).
version may be NULL or point to a requested version; interface_ must be a valid writable pointer.
flags may include CKF_INTERFACE_FORK_SAFE as supported.

functions.name: C_LoginUser
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_LoginUser(ck_session_handle_t session, ck_user_type_t user_type, unsigned char *pin, unsigned long pin_len, unsigned char *username, unsigned long username_len)
functions.description: Logs a user in with both PIN and a username/identifier (vendor/extended interface).
requirements: session must be valid.
user_type must be supported by the token.
pin/pin_len and username/username_len must reference valid buffers if required by the token.

functions.name: C_SessionCancel
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SessionCancel(ck_session_handle_t session, ck_flags_t flags)
functions.description: Cancels outstanding operations on a session according to the given flags.
requirements: session must be valid.
flags semantics are provider-defined within PKCS #11 v3 context; unsupported flags may be rejected.

functions.name: C_MessageEncryptInit
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_MessageEncryptInit(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, ck_object_handle_t key)
functions.description: Initializes message-based encryption for AEAD-style APIs introduced in v3.x.
requirements: session must be valid and not in a conflicting message operation.
mechanism must match the message encryption mode and parameters.
key must have CKA_ENCRYPT permitted.

functions.name: C_EncryptMessage
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_EncryptMessage(ck_session_handle_t session, void *parameter, unsigned long parameter_len, unsigned char *associated_data, unsigned long associated_data_len, unsigned char *plaintext, unsigned long plaintext_len, unsigned char *ciphertext, unsigned long *ciphertext_len)
functions.description: Performs single-call message encryption with optional associated data and mechanism-specific parameters.
requirements: session must be valid and message-encrypt initialized.
parameter/parameter_len must point to mechanism-specific parameters when required.
associated_data may be NULL or a valid buffer; plaintext/plaintext_len must be valid.
ciphertext_len must be writable; ciphertext may be NULL to query required size.

functions.name: C_EncryptMessageBegin
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_EncryptMessageBegin(ck_session_handle_t session, void *parameter, unsigned long parameter_len, unsigned char *associated_data, unsigned long associated_data_len)
functions.description: Begins a multi-part message encryption with optional associated data.
requirements: session must be valid and message-encrypt initialized.
parameter/parameter_len must be valid for the mechanism.
associated_data may be NULL or valid buffer.

functions.name: C_EncryptMessageNext
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_EncryptMessageNext(ck_session_handle_t session, void *parameter, unsigned long parameter_len, unsigned char *plaintext_part, unsigned long plaintext_part_len, unsigned char *ciphertext_part, unsigned long *ciphertext_part_len, ck_flags_t flags)
functions.description: Continues a multi-part message encryption, processing a plaintext chunk and returning corresponding ciphertext.
requirements: session must be valid and in an active message-encrypt sequence.
parameter may be NULL or mechanism-specific per step; plaintext_part/len valid input.
ciphertext_part_len must be writable; ciphertext_part may be NULL to query size.
flags may include CKF_END_OF_MESSAGE to indicate final chunk.

functions.name: C_MessageEncryptFinal
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_MessageEncryptFinal(ck_session_handle_t session)
functions.description: Finalizes a multi-part message encryption operation.
requirements: session must be valid and in a message-encrypt operation.

functions.name: C_MessageDecryptInit
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_MessageDecryptInit(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, ck_object_handle_t key)
functions.description: Initializes message-based decryption for AEAD-style APIs.
requirements: session must be valid and not in a conflicting message operation.
mechanism must match the message decryption mode and parameters.
key must allow CKA_DECRYPT.

functions.name: C_DecryptMessage
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DecryptMessage(ck_session_handle_t session, void *parameter, unsigned long parameter_len, unsigned char *associated_data, unsigned long associated_data_len, unsigned char *ciphertext, unsigned long ciphertext_len, unsigned char *plaintext, unsigned long *plaintext_len)
functions.description: Performs single-call message decryption with optional associated data and mechanism-specific parameters.
requirements: session must be valid and message-decrypt initialized.
parameter/parameter_len valid for mechanism.
associated_data may be NULL or valid; ciphertext/ciphertext_len must be valid.
plaintext_len must be writable; plaintext may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_DecryptMessageBegin
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DecryptMessageBegin(ck_session_handle_t session, void *parameter, unsigned long parameter_len, unsigned char *associated_data, unsigned long associated_data_len)
functions.description: Begins a multi-part message decryption with optional associated data.
requirements: session must be valid and message-decrypt initialized.
parameter/parameter_len must be valid; associated_data optional or valid.

functions.name: C_DecryptMessageNext
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_DecryptMessageNext(ck_session_handle_t session, void *parameter, unsigned long parameter_len, unsigned char *ciphertext_part, unsigned long ciphertext_part_len, unsigned char *plaintext_part, unsigned long *plaintext_part_len, ck_flags_t flags)
functions.description: Continues multi-part message decryption, processing a ciphertext chunk and returning plaintext.
requirements: session must be valid and in an active message-decrypt sequence.
parameter may be NULL or mechanism-specific; ciphertext_part/len valid input.
plaintext_part_len must be writable; plaintext_part may be NULL to query size.
flags may include CKF_END_OF_MESSAGE to indicate final chunk.

functions.name: C_MessageDecryptFinal
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_MessageDecryptFinal(ck_session_handle_t session)
functions.description: Finalizes a multi-part message decryption operation.
requirements: session must be valid and in a message-decrypt operation.

functions.name: C_MessageSignInit
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_MessageSignInit(ck_session_handle_t session, struct ck_mechanism *mechanism, ck_object_handle_t key)
functions.description: Initializes message-based signing.
requirements: session must be valid and not in a conflicting message operation.
mechanism must match the message signing mode and parameters.
key must allow CKA_SIGN.

functions.name: C_SignMessage
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SignMessage(ck_session_handle_t session, void *parameter, unsigned long parameter_len, unsigned char *data, unsigned long data_len, unsigned char *signature, unsigned long *signature_len)
functions.description: Performs single-call message signing with optional mechanism parameters.
requirements: session must be valid and message-sign initialized.
parameter/parameter_len valid for mechanism.
data/data_len valid input; signature_len must be writable; signature may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_SignMessageBegin
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SignMessageBegin(ck_session_handle_t session, void *parameter, unsigned long parameter_len)
functions.description: Begins a multi-part message signing operation.
requirements: session must be valid and message-sign initialized.
parameter/parameter_len must be valid for the mechanism.

functions.name: C_SignMessageNext
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_SignMessageNext(ck_session_handle_t session, void *parameter, unsigned long parameter_len, unsigned char *data, unsigned long data_len, unsigned char *signature, unsigned long *signature_len)
functions.description: Continues a multi-part message signing operation, possibly emitting signatures per chunk as defined by mechanism.
requirements: session must be valid and in an active message-sign sequence.
parameter may be NULL or mechanism-specific; data/data_len valid input.
signature_len must be writable; signature may be NULL to query size.

functions.name: C_MessageSignFinal
functions.signature: ck_rv_t C_MessageSignFinal(ck_session_handle_t session)
functions.description: Finalizes a multi-part message signing operation.

import os
import random
import string
from typing import List

# Data type: filesystem path
# Target stubs call FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME() to obtain a filename-like string used as:
# - p11_kit_uri_set_module_path(uri, path)
# - p11_kit_uri_set_pinfile(uri, pinfile)
# - p11_kit_module_load(path, flags)
# Our goal: generate a bytes buffer that the harness will map to a filename with interesting valid paths.
# The buffer should contain a plausible POSIX-style path. We'll include a small corpus of
# interesting, valid-looking paths and also synthesize random but sensible paths, keeping length <= 4096.

_SEP = "/"

# Interesting fixed seeds covering edge and common cases
_FIXED_PATHS: List[str] = [
    "/usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so",
    "/usr/local/lib/pkcs11/opensc-pkcs11.so",
    "/usr/lib64/pkcs11/p11-kit-client.so",
    "/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/pkcs11/p11-kit-trust.so",
    "/System/Library/Security/tokend/pkcs11.dylib",
    "/tmp/pinfile.txt",
    "/tmp/.hidden/pin",
    "/var/run/p11kit/socket",
    "/etc/pkcs11/modules/test.module",
    "/home/user/.config/p11-kit/pin",
    "./relative/module.so",
    "../up/one/level/module.so",
    "/dev/null",
    "/tmp/ümlaut/pkcs11/модуль.so",
    "/tmp/a"  # very short file name
]

# Reasonable file extensions for modules and pinfiles
_EXTS = [".so", ".dylib", ".dll", ".module", ".txt", "", ".conf"]

# Common directories to assemble plausible paths
_DIRS = [
    "/usr/lib", "/usr/lib64", "/usr/local/lib", "/lib", "/lib64",
    "/usr/lib/pkcs11", "/usr/lib64/pkcs11", "/usr/local/lib/pkcs11",
    "/etc/pkcs11/modules", "/tmp", "/var/tmp", "/var/run", "/opt/pkcs11",
    "/home/user", "/home/fuzz", "/tmp/.cache", ".", ".."
]

# Components to combine into a filename
_BASENAMES = [
    "p11-kit-client", "p11-kit-trust", "opensc-pkcs11", "libsofthsm2",
    "pkcs11", "module", "token", "pin", "pinfile", "config",
    "driver", "provider", "engine"
]

_UNI_CHARS = "äöüÄÖÜßñåÅøØéèêçœάβγμ日本語русский"


def _rand_basename(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    choice = rng.choice(_BASENAMES)
    # Occasionally append digits or variant
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        choice += str(rng.randint(0, 9))
    if rng.random() < 0.3:
        choice = "lib" + choice
    return choice


def _rand_ext(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    return rng.choice(_EXTS)


def _rand_dir(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    d = rng.choice(_DIRS)
    # Occasionally add nested subdirs
    depth = rng.randint(0, 3)
    for _ in range(depth):
        # directory component: letters, digits, underscore, or some unicode
        comp_chars = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "_-"
        if rng.random() < 0.2:
            comp_chars += _UNI_CHARS
        comp_len = rng.randint(1, 10)
        comp = "".join(rng.choice(comp_chars) for _ in range(comp_len))
        if d in (".", ".."):
            d = d + _SEP + comp
        else:
            d = d.rstrip(_SEP) + _SEP + comp
    return d


def _make_random_path(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Decide absolute vs relative
    if rng.random() < 0.8:
        d = _rand_dir(rng)
    else:
        d = "."
    base = _rand_basename(rng) + _rand_ext(rng)
    # Occasionally insert unicode into basename
    if rng.random() < 0.2:
        base += rng.choice(_UNI_CHARS)
    # Possibly hidden file
    if rng.random() < 0.2:
        base = "." + base
    # Join
    if d in (".", ".."):
        path = d + _SEP + base
    else:
        path = d.rstrip(_SEP) + _SEP + base
    return path


def _build_corpus(rng: random.Random) -> List[str]:
    paths = list(_FIXED_PATHS)
    # Add a few random variants
    n_rand = rng.randint(5, 12)
    for _ in range(n_rand):
        paths.append(_make_random_path(rng))
    # Mix in extension variations for common basenames
    for base in ("p11-kit-client", "opensc-pkcs11", "libsofthsm2"):
        for ext in (".so", ".dylib", ".dll"):
            paths.append(rf"/tmp/{base}{ext}")
    # Deduplicate while preserving order
    seen = set()
    unique = []
    for p in paths:
        if p not in seen:
            seen.add(p)
            unique.append(p)
    return unique


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    corpus = _build_corpus(rng)
    # Choose one path weighted: prefer existing fixed/common ones sometimes
    if rng.random() < 0.6:
        path = rng.choice(corpus)
    else:
        path = _make_random_path(rng)

    # Optionally add a trailing newline or not: many file path consumers accept raw C strings,
    # but fuzz harness likely slices to C string; avoid NULs and keep plain.
    # Keep under 4096 bytes
    s = path
    if len(s) > 4090:
        s = s[:4090]
    return s.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
